blocks.html: The details to update a claim's outbound item.

types.name: claim_id
types.description: The ID of the claim to update the outbound item in.

types.name: action_id
types.description:
The ID of the action associated with the item to update.
Every item has an `actions` property, whose value is an array of actions.
You can find the action with the name `ITEM_ADD` using the item's `action` property,
and use the value of the action's `id` property.

types.name: data
types.description: The details to update in the outbound item.

children.name: quantity
children.description: The new quantity of the item.

children.name: internal_note
children.description: A note viewed by admins only related to the item.
